04 · Projects

Selected work

A team road-safety analysis from my NTI training, followed by dashboards I built in training exercises. Every screenshot comes from the original Power BI or Excel file.

Team project · NTI Data Analytics Training

Road Traffic Accidents Analysis

  • Python
  • Pandas
  • Power Query
  • MySQL
  • Power BI
288Kinjuries, 2022 to 2025
25Kdeaths, 2022 to 2025
4 pagesin the Power BI dashboard

A team analysis of road accident injuries and deaths across Egypt, broken down by year, month, governorate, gender, age group, road user and vehicle type. The data model uses fact and dimension tables.

My part: the SQL analysis, comparing injuries and deaths across those breakdowns.

Results the team reported

20242025Change
Injuries76,36284,553+10.7%
Deaths5,2605,829+10.8%
  • Dakahlia recorded 17,975 injuries in 2025. Across 2022 to 2025 it also has the most injuries of any governorate, about 60K.
  • October 2025 recorded 8,245 injuries, and March 2025 recorded 583 deaths.

These are the project's reported results, not a separate analysis of my own.
